title: ARC-RGBT
description: Research on visible–thermal image fusion for object detection in challenging conditions, with emphasis on the reliability limits of multisensor approaches.

title: ARC-RVI · Autonomous Visual Inspection
description: Development of autonomous visual inspection methods for target localisation, viewpoint planning and assessment of the completeness and quality of robot-generated imagery.

title: ARC-HRI-SAFETY
description: Development of risk-prediction methods for human–humanoid collaboration based on scene perception, motion analysis and safety constraints.

title: ARC-AFFECTIVE
description: Research on task-related fluctuations in attention and cognitive workload, including XR settings. Development of personalised user-state estimation from Muse S Athena EEG and behavioural data.

title: XR-Cognition · Adaptive Cognitive Environments
description: Development of adaptive XR environments that adjust task difficulty and stimulus presentation to current cognitive capacity. Research on feedback using EEG, eye tracking and behavioural data.

title: ContextNDD
description: Development of context-sensitive behavioural analysis methods that account for individual differences without reducing user profiles to diagnostic labels.

title: SAPIENS · Human–Humanoid Interaction
description: Research on the effects of direct human–humanoid interaction on trust, agency, social presence and the interpretation of emotional cues.

title: ARC Mobile Eye Tracking
description: Research on smartphone-based gaze estimation and the effects of calibration, lighting and head movement on measurement accuracy.

title: EEG Neurolyze
description: Development of Muse S Athena EEG acquisition and analysis tools with data-quality checks. Planned support for cognitive experiments, event synchronisation and XR integration; physical recordings require validation.

title: S4D-TAM · Autonomous Navigation
description: Development of autonomous navigation evaluation methods for GNSS-degraded conditions using scene semantics and 3D/4D spatial data.

title: ARC Attachment Dynamics
description: Research on dynamic changes in closeness, autonomy and perceived security in relationships through attachment theory and dynamic modelling.

title: ARC-ADHD · Adaptive Research Game
description: Development of an adaptive research game investigating recovery of goal-directed behaviour after challenging stimuli, distinguishing task gains from transfer beyond the game.

title: AI Cognitive Resilience
description: Research on how evidence quality and the strength and framing of AI-generated persuasion influence belief change.

sourceTitle: DERA-HRI · Emocje w interakcji z robotem
title: DERA-HRI · Emotions in Robot Interaction
description: Development of an instrument for studying emotional responses and experiences during robot interaction, including responsiveness, trust and perceived control.

title: MindDx · Psychological Assessment Simulator
description: Development of an interactive learning environment for case analysis, hypothesis formulation and diagnostic decision-making without risk to real patients.

title: ARIANA
description: A multimodal affect-research platform concept combining eye tracking, visible/infrared imaging, movement sensing and psychometrics.

title: PIAST · Satellite Earth Observation
description: Work within a three-nanosatellite Earth-observation programme advancing Polish optoelectronics and imaging capabilities.

title: SEEKER · Optoelectronic Seekers
description: Development of multispectral and imaging optoelectronic systems for defence applications, including prototyping and verification.

title: PolFEL · Free-Electron Laser
description: Participation in the development of Poland's first free-electron laser infrastructure for studying ultrafast processes in matter.

title: OPTOKRYPT · Quantum Cryptography
description: Research into optical information-security technologies, including quantum random-number generation and secure key distribution.

title: Ocular Micromovements · Potential Neurodegeneration Biomarkers
description: Research on monitoring small eye movements and analysing oculomotor features as potential biomarkers of neurodegenerative disorders, accounting for measurement and interpretation limitations.

title: Eye Tracking in Mixed Reality
description: Leading research into gaze-based control and interaction with objects in mixed-reality environments.

sourceTitle: Systemy wizyjne XR w nauce i obronności
title: XR Vision Systems for Research and Defence
description: Leading research on mixed-reality vision systems for scientific experiments and military applications.

title: RiverGUARD · River-Border Monitoring
description: Work on an optoelectronic monitoring and protection system for river borders in challenging field conditions.

title: 3D Sub-THz Scanner
description: Participation in an active 3D sub-terahertz scanner project for non-contact security screening.

title: GROM / PIORUN Trainer Sensor
description: Development of a sensor for a virtual GROM/PIORUN anti-aircraft system trainer supporting realistic operator training.

title: PROTECT · Border-Control Biometrics
description: A European project exploring less intrusive and more robust border controls through multimodal biometrics and privacy safeguards.
